proofs.text: Open the regulated fixture and open the review list; verify the reason cell of the high-risk `RULE-1`, whose only reason is its risk, is empty and that zero risk tags are on screen; verify the row of the stale `RULE-2` reads `stale`, that `RULE-4` reads `windows: no record yet`, and that the invoice row reads `strength 64% under 80%` beside the sentence `No proof of this rule names a rejection, an error or a boundary.`

rule_text: A review row states a reason only where it says more than the risk group already does, reading a stale approval as `stale`, a test strength under the minimum as `strength <n>% under <m>%`, a free check as the sentence the checks write, code that moved under an approval as `re-verify pending`, and an operating system with no record as `<os>: no record yet`; a rule whose only reason is its risk states none, and no row repeats its group's risk as a tag

tests.body:
def test_a_row_whose_only_reason_is_its_risk_states_none(browser, tmp_path):
    """The group header already said `high risk`; the row adds nothing."""
    page = open_board(browser, tmp_path, payload_named('regulated'))
    page.click('[data-screen="review"]')
    assert review_cells(page)[0][4] == ''
    assert page.query_selector_all('.rev .tag') == []
    page.close()
tests.name: test_a_row_states_every_reason_the_group_does_not
